As the article published in Říčansko suggests, we're now looking into building trails around Říčany, which would free up forest paths for walkers and slightly discourage the building of some illegal trails – because why do something illegally when it could be done together and legally?

Moreover, when it comes to trails, Říčany – a town that lives for cycling – is missing something like this. The route study was prepared by Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, and it looks like recreational riders could enjoy it, as well as – thanks to smaller side lines – those who can ride.
